REJECT
`Next` probably still exceeds 15: the extracted export-parsing logic accounts for roughly 35 of the original 49 points, and the patch adds `for` (+1) and a nested `if` (+2) inside `Next`, which puts the remaining code above the line before 347 (the nested `url` ternaries and the route-kind checks) at roughly 17, though I couldn't count that earlier code directly. Behaviour looks preserved; the build may fail because the new signatures name `Lexed` and `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>`, types the original code never spelled out, and I couldn't confirm they exist.
